# Preserved upstream license and notice texts

These unmodified files came from the locally installed versions pinned in requirements files and frontend/package-lock.json. inventory.json records package, version, original file, destination and SHA-256. Source/binaries of these dependencies are not included. Licenses here remain upstream material and are excluded from the root MIT grant. See ../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for scope.

Python notices cover direct runtime and optional development dependencies. npm notices cover installed locked packages with root license/notice files; platform-specific optional packages not installed on Windows are not redistributed and their lockfile license metadata remains available. An eventual binary/container bundle needs a complete bundle-specific inventory, not just this source-release notice set.
